verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office and incorporation platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence shows no sandbox, test mode, or developer environment. The probes found no public OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, so there is no sign of a developer surface where a sandbox would live.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
